source_locator: Document '08-28-2012 Final Precinct Text File.txt', contest 'MAYOR - TOWN OF GILBERT'. Votes are the citywide total; precinct-level files are summed over all precincts.
verification_note: Maricopa County official results list LEWIS, JOHN 18748 and BERMAN, STEVE 7986 under 'MAYOR - TOWN OF GILBERT'. The write-in line took 48 votes. Lewis took a majority at the primary, so no mayoral contest appears in the county's November 2012 file, and the town register records 'John Lewis elected Mayor' against the August primary. Total mayoral votes 26782; the winner took 70.0 percent. Arizona law, A.R.S. 9-821.01(D), lets a town declare a candidate elected at the primary when that candidate takes a majority of all votes cast for the office. Gilbert's own pages show that it uses this rule: the General Elections page states there is no runoff for council candidates on the November 2026 ballot, and the Primary Elections page records four councilmembers elected at the July 21, 2026 primary. The town clerk's register confirms the pattern for the mayoral office: a November mayoral contest appears in 2020 alone, the one year in which no candidate reached a majority at the primary.
